claims.claim: 1974 traffic-film experiment varied verb in speed question
claims.limitation: May describe the tested manipulation, not mass mind control.

claims.claim: The film shown to the tested group contained no broken glass
claims.limitation: No film reproduction or full protocol replication performed.

claims.claim: In study two smashed group more likely to report glass a week later
claims.limitation: Do not extrapolate to all memory, hypnosis or brainwashing.

claims.claim: Misinformation after events can affect subsequent memory reports
claims.limitation: Outcome and susceptibility depend on circumstances.

claims.claim: Hypnotic suggestion mechanisms have no scientific consensus
claims.limitation: Independent theory review, not a seller product study.

claims.claim: A hypnosis review reviewed 49 meta-analyses
claims.limitation: Most evidence clinical and uneven methodological quality.

claims.claim: Only nine included meta-analyses ranked high methodological quality
claims.limitation: Do not apply positive clinical outcomes to retail focus recordings.

claims.claim: Puységur archive includes operator pressure and consent conflicts
claims.limitation: Source-content finding, not efficacy proof.

claims.claim: FV currently supplies one free Focus Fieldbook
claims.limitation: Provider-confirmed subscriber counts not verified this run.

claims.claim: Zen12 Beginner offers first six levels / 24 MP3s
claims.limitation: Can describe contents; verify checkout and fulfillment.

claims.claim: Zen12 Premium offers twelve levels / 48 MP3s
claims.limitation: Can describe contents; not proof of efficacy.

claims.claim: Zen12 Advanced offers final six levels / 24 MP3s
claims.limitation: Can describe contents; not equivalence to Premium.

claims.claim: Zen12 page displays prices of 67.77 / 87.99 / 67.77 USD
claims.limitation: 13 Nov 2026 display only; final checkout unverified.

claims.claim: Zen12 advertises one-year money-back guarantee
claims.limitation: Conditions, processing and actual refunds untested.

claims.claim: Zen12 says one 12-minute session equals hour meditation benefits
claims.limitation: Do not adopt or imply as proven.

claims.claim: Zen12 says audio can increase concentration and benefit health
claims.limitation: No product-specific adequate independent evidence established.

claims.claim: Zen12 free audio enrolls visitor in merchant newsletter
claims.limitation: Do not merge merchant and FV mailing lists or hide opt-in.

claims.claim: Hypnosis Live Total Focus sold as 33-minute / 47 MB recording
claims.limitation: Written and recorded by J.A. Amos, seller page.

claims.claim: Total Focus page displays 24.44 USD single price
claims.limitation: 13 Nov 2026 seller display, not authenticated checkout.

claims.claim: Total Focus can reprogram brain into 100% focus
claims.limitation: Exclude from positive FV sales copy.

claims.claim: Focus Shot offers 15-minute and 30-minute tracks
claims.limitation: Includes sound-only variations per seller; verify delivery.

claims.claim: Focus Shot page displays 17.99 USD
claims.limitation: 13 Nov 2026 seller display, final checkout unverified.

claims.claim: Focus Shot creates four hours or more of focus
claims.limitation: Do not repeat as independent finding.

claims.claim: Public Inspire3 portal offers affiliate signup
claims.limitation: Not publisher acceptance, earning URL or allowed channel terms.

claims.claim: FV accepted as approved publisher for all these products
claims.limitation: Public affiliate marketing copy does not prove this.

claims.claim: FVs Payhip Mind SKU rights, checkout, fulfillment, refunds verified
claims.limitation: Free Fieldbook is not a paid SKU. No private Payhip audit.

claims.claim: Affiliate financial connection needs clear near-link disclosure
claims.limitation: Proposed exact language adjacent to disabled CTA.

claims.claim: Health performance claims require relevant substantiation
claims.limitation: No implied medical guarantees or general-study laundering.

claims.claim: Traffic clicks are equivalent to independently paid commissions
claims.limitation: Only merchant-ledger paid events qualify.

claims.claim: A text/video A/B can establish lifted conversion before authentic buyer data
claims.limitation: No conversion effect established; require randomized consent-safe evidence.
